entities.summary: "Superstar" is a song by American singer-songwriter Madonna from her twelfth studio album MDNA (2012). It was released on December 3, 2012, in Brazil only as a special edition free CD with Brazilian newspaper Folha de S.Paulo. The song was written and produced by Madonna, Hardy "Indigo" Muanza and Michael Malih and is a dance-pop track, which has electronic and pop influences. Instrumentation featured in "Superstar" includes guitars and drum machines. Lyrically, Madonna compares her boyfriend with famous men, such as John Travolta, Abraham Lincoln, Al Capone, among others and claims to be his "biggest fan".

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Although 'Superstar' had a moderate commercial success and peaked at number one on the US Billboard Dance Club Songs chart, its impact was limited to the global pop music scene. It is notable for being Madonna's first song released outside of North America.
